Unscripted: Zu Besuch im Informatik-Studium
Is studying computer science only for math experts? Is computer science also for women?
The host, Lena, visits the "Programming Project" lecture. There, she not only gets to try out a computer game developed during the course but also has many of her questions about studying computer science answered by students Andrina and Maria. [in German]
